decisions.decision: Seed must run inside the backend container (docker exec saher-backend-1 'cd /app && pnpm seed'), not on host
decisions.rationale: Host pnpm seed resolves the wrong MONGO_URI outside the compose network (ENOTFOUND mongo) and writes nowhere the app reads
